description: This Georgia Institute of Technology deposit records 3,395 workplace electric-vehicle charging sessions involving 85 drivers and 105 charging stations at 25 sites within one participating firm. The sites include manufacturing, research and office facilities. Session variables describe timing, electricity delivered, charging cost and user categories, with timestamps rounded to the nearest second. Harvard Dataverse version 4 applies CC0 and offers a tabular file converted from the documented CSV representation, allowing free reuse. The own landing metadata does not establish the complete acquisition calendar. These observations can calibrate workplace arrival and charging assumptions in infrastructure simulations such as model-emobpy and complement the broader data-doe-ev-data-collection-charging collection. A caveat is that one employer's stations and participating drivers do not represent all workplaces or public charging behaviour. Session observations also do not independently describe rejected charging requests or unmet demand. The table was not downloaded, and no driver-level reconstruction or numerical validation was attempted.
